name: m_tofu_idle
prompt: Idle loop facing right: the flame spirit bobs gently up and down in place, flames flickering, blinking its eyes. Same framing and same ground line every frame, seamless loop.

name: m_tofu_move
prompt: Turn to a side profile facing right and move to the right in a seamless 8-frame loop: the flame spirit hops to the right in small bouncy jumps, squashing on landing and stretching in the air, flame tips trailing back. Same scale and ground line in every frame.

name: m_tofu_attack
